dog.description_text:
Anna is happy-go-lucky. She has playful puppy energy and gets stopped everywhere she goes because people want to say hi, and she happily accepts their pets. She's food motivated and is taking well to training. She knows sit, down, paw, look at me, and leave it. We're working on drop it, spin, wait, and general impulse control.

She settles easily in her crate, is house-trained, and doesn't come onto the couch unless invited. She likes to nap on the floor near me while I work or cook, a perfect little buddy to keep you company, but she can also entertain herself with chew toys. She can get overexcited playing fetch, but will slow down at your direction.

Anna has a tendency to pull on her leash when being walked in new places, but in familiar settings she'll settle into your pace and is very calm. She'll notice other dogs, but it's been fairly easy to refocus her on treats. I've seen her lunge at squirrels in the park, but she loses interest after a few moments and will settle calmly.

She's settling into city living nicely, potties on the pavement, and doesn't seem bothered by the noise, though walking through crowds isn't fun because she's on the short side. She sniffs around, but doesn't pick up or eat trash/food that's on the street. She also doesn't beg while I'm eating, but will sit at my feet. Anna's pretty easy going and would make an amazing addition your family.

﻿Anna is approximately 4y 1m 28d old and is fully grown at 44.6 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
